hypothesis: Raw-invalid walks at repeated chain endpoints can be decomposed into simple closed cycles without altering labels/curves. This representation change may permit unchanged local B guards; visible completeness may remain unchanged.

conditions.O: Saved baseline graph, reused not refit
conditions.R: Decompose face walks at repeated exact chain endpoints, preserve every directed per-label chain occurrence
conditions.B: Saved prior guarded graph reused, not rerun
conditions.RB: Identical unchanged prior guard applied to R only after invariance gates

representation.geometry_changes: none; same chain IDs, all segments/raw vertices/incidence/regionIDs/labels
representation.chain_splitting: forbidden; internal-only repeat blocks affected walk
representation.new_objects: Only loop lists, no new path/chain/label/region/stroke
representation.rollback: If an endpoint walk is open or decomposition loses directed occurrence, reject and retain original walk; RB only if whole-case controls pass

matched_controls.chains: JSON equality and unchanged labels bytes
matched_controls.raw_render_equivalence: Whole region-ID SVG exact RGBA pixel equality O vs R at native and8x; all label identities included, not foreground only
matched_controls.raw_signed_area: Each original raw walk sum of split signed areas must agree <=1e-9
matched_controls.fitted_render_equivalence: O vs R8x must match; mismatch is a failure of pure representation premise, block RB
matched_controls.B_guard: Import unchanged EXP_THIN_STRUCTURE_TOPOLOGY_01/track_b.py, exact frozen configuration; grouping/target denominators may change and must be disclosed

evaluation.inherit: Prior frozen known-control and critical-component policies unchanged
evaluation.ring_denominators: Report original mapping and all new cycles; count reductions alone cannot establish repair
evaluation.validity: Raw/fitted rings, pinches/junction order, chain-pair defects, shared references, signed area, holes and containment, numerical coverage, actual SVG8xownership differences
evaluation.structure: Known IoU/components/holes, named Shield interior guide coverage, actual native/4x/16xdrawings; fixed-label missing details cannot be invented
evaluation.anti_mosaic: No new chain geometry/cells, old1/2/4pxdistributions+visible2pxalarm10percent retained; existing tiny regions not automatically meaningful

discovery_probe.scope: Independent evidence-only assessment, no label/graph mutation, no final geometric acceptance
discovery_probe.input: Native source RGB only; no labels/refs/ROIs supplied constructor
discovery_probe.method: CannyLab channel union at sigma.6,1.2; SatoL both polarities at sigmas.7,1.2,2
discovery_probe.sato: Keep response float maps, no segmentation threshold
discovery_probe.evaluation_only: Persistent source edges>2pxfrom inherited raw cracks; no new truth claims
discovery_probe.search: none; no parameter tuning; stop branch on resource limit or unauditable dense evidence
discovery_probe.outputs: NPZmaps, source overlays and assessment; no new reconstruction engine

failure_and_stop: Raw/fitted rendering equivalence fails: preserve negative, no RB oncase
No safeBunblocking: reportrepresentation-onlynegative, do not weaken guards
No visible completeness gain: no geometryacceptance, recommend discoveryratherthan indefinite repair
No new production architecture/appearance or MagicLayers
